blogs.title: The 1.58-Bit Revolution: How Ternary Logic Can Compete with Full-Precision AI
blogs.description: A deep dive into the core breakthrough of "BitNet b1.58." This post explains the counter-intuitive concept that lowering AI model precision to ternary values (-1, 0, 1) allows models to match or exceed full-precision (FP16) performance while drastically cutting costs.

blogs.title: Beyond Standard Quantization: Why 4-Bit Isn't Enough for Next-Gen LLMs
blogs.description: This article analyzes the limitations of current industry-standard quantization techniques (like GPTQ or AWQ) and why moving further down to the 'edge' with 1.58-bit models offers a new paradigm shift rather than just a minor optimization.

blogs.title: Hardware Magic: Why Energy-Saving Matrix Mults Are Key to Faster LLM Inference
blogs.description: Explaining the technical engine under the hood, this post breaks down how replacing standard floating-point matrix multiplications with integer addition in BitNet architecture leads to massive energy savings and latency reduction.

blogs.title: From Data Center to Your Pocket: The Promise of Edge-AI Computing
blogs.description: Focusing on practical applications, this blog post explores how the reduced memory footprint and energy consumption of 1-bit LLMs unlock possibilities for running powerful AI models on mobile devices and edge hardware where enterprise GPUs cannot fit.
